title: Blackjack Basics
intro: You play against the dealer. Goal: get 21 or beat the dealer without busting.

steps.say: Pick your stake from the ladder: click bet10 to deal a hand.
steps.tip: The bet buttons set what a hand is worth. Start small.
steps.praise: Bet placed. The cards are dealt and it is your turn.

steps.say: Raise the stake when you feel ready: click bet25 for the next hand.
steps.tip: Every bet is paid from the same wallet, so pick what you can afford.
steps.praise: A bigger stake. Blackjack pays 3:2 and a win pays even money.

steps.say: When you are confident, click bet100. The dealer stands on all 17s.
steps.tip: Keep enough chips for another hand; the table never ends on its own.
steps.praise: You know the ladder. Now play a hand: hit, stand or double.
